summary: Tried to close the end-to-end gap on the asserted witness-reporting defect by reusing the captured witness-cluster harness, but it starts the go-tcp transport and the isolation denies a listener on 127.0.0.1 (socket: operation not permitted), and no in-memory transport factory exists for a two-nodehost cluster. Recorded that concrete reason as an added limitation on the existing interpretation and restored the draft harness to the fixed object-level test; claim, defect status and cited receipt unchanged, no execution requested.
